from hfpef_catalog.data_loader import (

    count_all_species,

    get_species_profile,
    dataset_count,
    tissue_count,
    sex_distribution,
    omics_approach_count,
    filter_datasets,

)

# Carregamento inicial de todas as espécies
df_species = load_all_species()

# Consolidação dos dados
df_consolidated = consolidate_species(df_species)

# Normalização textual do DataFrame consolidado
df_consolidated = normalize_text_columns(df_consolidated)

# Indicadores gerais
total_species = count_all_species(df_species)
total_repo = len(df_consolidated)
```


# Introduction

This report presents a curated overview of transcriptomic datasets relevant to heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF). The repository aims to consolidate and organize available datasets, supporting their exploration and reuse in bioinformatics research.

# Metadata Dictionary

The repository uses a standardized metadata framework to describe the biological, experimental, and technical characteristics of each dataset. These metadata support dataset characterization, facilitate comparisons across studies, and inform the exploration of data availability and experimental diversity.

```{python}

#| output: asis
#| echo: false

print("::: {.panel-tabset}\n")

for species_name in sorted(metrics_summary):
    metrics = metrics_summary[species_name]
    display_name = species_name.replace("_", " ").capitalize()
    sex = metrics["Sex distribution"]

    print(f"## {display_name}\n")

    html_content = f"""
    <div class="species-profile">

        <div class="species-metrics-stack">

            <div class="overview-card">
                <p class="overview-label">Datasets catalogued</p>
                <p class="overview-value">{metrics["dataset_count"]}</p>
            </div>

            <div class="overview-card">
                <p class="overview-label">Sampled Tissue</p>
                <p class="overview-value">{metrics["Sampled tissue"]}</p>
            </div>

            <div class="overview-card">
                <p class="overview-label">Omics Approach</p>
                <p class="overview-value">{metrics["Omics approach"]}</p>
            </div>

        </div>

        <div class="sex-distribution-card">
            <p class="overview-label">Sex Distribution</p>

            <div class="sex-distribution-list">
    """

    for category in ["Female", "Male", "Male / female", "Not reported"]:
        percentage = sex[category]

        html_content += f"""
                <div class="sex-distribution-item">
                    <div class="sex-distribution-header">
                        <span>{category}</span>
                        <span>{percentage:.0f}%</span>
                    </div>

                    <div class="sex-progress-track">
                        <div
                            class="sex-progress-fill"
                            style="width: {percentage:.0f}%;">
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
        """

    html_content += """
            </div>
        </div>

    </div>
    """

    print("```{=html}")
    print(html_content)
    print("```")
    print()

print(":::")

# Dashboard 

```{python}

from shiny import ui, reactive, render
from shiny.express import ui as express_ui
from hfpef_catalog.processing import normalize_text_category
from hfpef_catalog.visualization import (
    create_horizontal_bar_chart,
    create_donut_chart,
    create_treemap_chart,
)

# Opções dos filtros:
species_choices = ["All species"] + sorted(
    df_consolidated["Species"].dropna().unique().tolist()
)

tissue_choices = sorted(df_consolidated["Sampled_Tissue"].dropna().unique().tolist())

sex_choices = sorted(df_consolidated["Sex"].dropna().unique().tolist())

omics_choices = sorted(df_consolidated["Omics_Approach"].dropna().unique().tolist())

platform_choices = sorted(df_consolidated["Platform"].dropna().unique().tolist())

raw_data_choices = sorted(
    df_consolidated["Raw_Data_Availability"].dropna().unique().tolist()
)

processed_data_choices = sorted(
    df_consolidated["Processed_Data_Availability"].dropna().unique().tolist()
)

# Estrutura visual do dashboard
with express_ui.div(class_="dashboard-layout"):
    # área principal
    with express_ui.div(class_="dashboard-main"):
        with express_ui.div(class_="dashboard-charts-grid"):

            @render.ui
            def omics_approach_chart():
                df = filtered_dataset()

                if df.empty:
                    return ui.p("No data available for the selected filters.")

                omics_counts = count_by_category(df, "Omics_Approach")

                fig = create_horizontal_bar_chart(
                    df=omics_counts,
                    x_column="Omics_Approach",
                    y_column="count",
                    title="Datasets by omics approach",
                    x_axis_title="Number of datasets",
                )

                return ui.HTML(
                    fig.to_html(
                        full_html=False,
                        include_plotlyjs=True,
                        config={"responsive": True},
                    )
                )

            @render.ui
            def sampled_tissue_chart():
                df = filtered_dataset()

                if df.empty:
                    return ui.p("No data available for the selected filters.")

                tissue_counts = count_by_category(df, "Sampled_Tissue")

                fig = create_horizontal_bar_chart(
                    df=tissue_counts,
                    x_column="Sampled_Tissue",
                    y_column="count",
                    title="Datasets by sampled tissue",
                    x_axis_title="Number of datasets",
                )

                return ui.HTML(
                    fig.to_html(
                        full_html=False,
                        include_plotlyjs=True,
                        config={"responsive": True},
                    )
                )

            @render.ui
            def sex_distribution_chart():
                df = filtered_dataset()

                if df.empty:
                    return ui.p("No data available for the selected filters.")

                sex_counts = count_by_category(df, "Sex")

                fig = create_donut_chart(
                    df=sex_counts,
                    category_column="Sex",
                    value_column="count",
                    title="Datasets by recorded biological sex",
                )

                return ui.HTML(
                    fig.to_html(
                        full_html=False,
                        include_plotlyjs=True,
                        config={"responsive": True},
                    )
                )

            @render.ui
            def platform_chart():
                df = filtered_dataset()

                if df.empty:
                    return ui.p("No data available for the selected  filters")

                df = df.copy()

                df["Platform"] = normalize_text_category(df["Platform"])

                df["Platform"] = df["Platform"].fillna("Blank in catalog")

                platform_counts = count_by_category(df, "Platform")

                fig = create_horizontal_bar_chart(
                    df=platform_counts,
                    x_column="Platform",
                    y_column="count",
                    title="Datasets by recorded sequencing platform",
                    x_axis_title="Number of datasets",
                )

                return ui.HTML(
                    fig.to_html(
                        full_html=False,
                        include_plotlyjs=True,
                        config={"responsive": True},
                    )
                )

        with express_ui.div(class_="dashboard-chart-wide"):

            @render.ui
            def molecular_biotype_chart():
                df = filtered_dataset()

                if df.empty:
                    return ui.p("No data available for the selected filters.")

                df = df.copy()

                df["Molecular_Biotype"] = normalize_text_category(
                    df["Molecular_Biotype"]
                )

                df["Molecular_Biotype"] = df["Molecular_Biotype"].fillna(
                    "Blank in catalog"
                )

                biotype_counts = count_by_category(
                    df,
                    "Molecular_Biotype",
                )

                fig = create_treemap_chart(
                    df=biotype_counts,
                    category_column="Molecular_Biotype",
                    value_column="count",
                    title="Datasets by molecular biotype",
                )

                return ui.HTML(
                    fig.to_html(
                        full_html=False,
                        include_plotlyjs=True,
                        config={"responsive": True},
                    )
                )

                # barra lateral: filtros e resultados relacionados

    with express_ui.div(class_="dashboard-sidebar"):
        ui.div(
            ui.h4("Filters"),
            ui.input_selectize(
                "species",
                "Species",
                choices=species_choices,
                selected="All species",
            ),
            ui.panel_conditional(
                "input.species && input.species !== 'All species'",
                ui.input_action_button("clear_species", "x Species"),
            ),
            ui.input_selectize(
                "sampled_tissue",
                "Sampled tissue",
                choices=tissue_choices,
                multiple=True,
            ),
            ui.panel_conditional(
                "input.sampled_tissue && input.sampled_tissue.length > 0",
                ui.input_action_button("clear_tissue", "x Sampled tissue"),
            ),
            ui.input_selectize(
                "sex",
                "Sex",
                choices=sex_choices,
                multiple=True,
            ),
            ui.panel_conditional(
                "input.sex && input.sex.length > 0",
                ui.input_action_button(
                    "clear_sex",
                    "× Sex",
                ),
            ),
            ui.input_selectize(
                "omics_approach",
                "Omics_approach",
                choices=omics_choices,
                multiple=True,
            ),
            ui.panel_conditional(
                "input.omics_approach && input.omics_approach.length > 0",
                ui.input_action_button("clear_omics", "x Omics approach"),
            ),
            ui.input_selectize(
                "platform",
                "Platform",
                choices=platform_choices,
                multiple=True,
            ),
            ui.panel_conditional(
                "input.platform && input.platform.length > 0",
                ui.input_action_button("clear_platform", "x Platform"),
            ),
            ui.input_selectize(
                "raw_data_availability",
                "Raw data availability",
                choices=raw_data_choices,
                multiple=True,
            ),
            ui.panel_conditional(
                "input.raw_data_availability && input.raw_data_availability.length > 0",
                ui.input_action_button("clear_raw_data", "x Raw data availability"),
            ),
            ui.input_selectize(
                "processed_data_availability",
                "Processed data availability",
                choices=processed_data_choices,
                multiple=True,
            ),
            ui.panel_conditional(
                "input.processed_data_availability && input.processed_data_availability.length >0",
                ui.input_action_button(
                    "clear_processed_data", "x Processed data availability"
                ),
            ),
            ui.input_action_button(
                "clear_all_filters",
                "Clear all filters",
            ),
        )

        with express_ui.div(class_="dashboard-active-filters"):

            @render.ui
            def active_filters():
                active_filters_list = []

                selected_species = input.species()
                if selected_species != "All species":
                    active_filters_list.append(f"Species: {selected_species}")

                filter_inputs = {
                    "Sampled tissue": input.sampled_tissue(),
                    "Sex": input.sex(),
                    "Omics approach": input.omics_approach(),
                    "Platform": input.platform(),
                    "Raw data availability": input.raw_data_availability(),
                    "Processed data availability": input.processed_data_availability(),
                }

                for filter_name, selected_values in filter_inputs.items():
                    if selected_values:
                        for value in selected_values:
                            active_filters_list.append(f"{filter_name}: {value}")

                if not active_filters_list:
                    return ui.p("No active filters.")

                return ui.TagList(
                    ui.h4("Active filters"),
                    ui.tags.ul(*[ui.tags.li(value) for value in active_filters_list]),
                )


@reactive.calc
def filtered_dataset():
    selected_species = input.species()
    selected_tissues = input.sampled_tissue()
    selected_sex = input.sex()
    selected_omics = input.omics_approach()
    selected_platform = input.platform()
    select_raw_data = input.raw_data_availability()
    selected_processed_data = input.processed_data_availability()

    if selected_species == "All species":
        selected_species = None

    if not selected_tissues:
        selected_tissues = None

    if not selected_sex:
        selected_sex = None

    if not selected_omics:
        selected_omics = None

    if not selected_platform:
        selected_platform = None

    if not select_raw_data:
        select_raw_data = None

    if not selected_processed_data:
        selected_processed_data = None

    return filter_datasets(
        df_consolidated,
        Species=selected_species,
        Sampled_Tissue=selected_tissues,
        Sex=selected_sex,
        Omics_Approach=selected_omics,
        Platform=selected_platform,
        Raw_Data_Availability=select_raw_data,
        Processed_Data_Availability=selected_processed_data,
    )


@reactive.effect
def _():
    df = filtered_dataset()


@reactive.effect
def _():
    if input.clear_sex():
        ui.update_selectize(
            "sex",
            selected=[],
        )

    if input.clear_species():
        ui.update_select("species", selected="All species")

    if input.clear_tissue():
        ui.update_selectize(
            "sampled_tissue",
            selected=[],
        )

    if input.clear_omics():
        ui.update_selectize(
            "omics_approach",
            selected=[],
        )

    if input.clear_platform():
        ui.update_selectize(
            "platform",
            selected=[],
        )

    if input.clear_raw_data():
        ui.update_selectize(
            "raw_data_availability",
            selected=[],
        )

    if input.clear_processed_data():
        ui.update_selectize(
            "processed_data_availability",
            selected=[],
        )


@reactive.effect
def _():
    if input.clear_all_filters():
        ui.update_select(
            "species",
            selected="All species",
        )

        ui.update_selectize(
            "sampled_tissue",
            selected=[],
        )

        ui.update_selectize(
            "sex",
            selected=[],
        )

        ui.update_selectize(
            "omics_approach",
            selected=[],
        )

        ui.update_selectize(
            "platform",
            selected=[],
        )

        ui.update_selectize(
            "raw_data_availability",
            selected=[],
        )

        ui.update_selectize(
            "processed_data_availability",
            selected=[],
        )


@render.table
def dataset_preview():
    return filtered_dataset()
